summary: Heidmar Maritime Holdings Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 1, 2026 press release reporting second-quarter and first-half 2026 results. Q2 revenue was $29.0 million versus $9.6 million a year earlier; net income attributable to shareholders was $2.2 million, or $0.04 per basic share, with adjusted net income of $2.4 million. First-half revenue reached $47.3 million versus $15.2 million, with net income of $5.0 million, or $0.08 per share. Cash was $28.7 million at June 30, 2026. The company added seven commercially managed vessels. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation.
